tips.text: Start Concussive Blows with Winter's Bite or an auto, then tell your carry to hit the marked enemy. The fourth stack stuns.
Aim Winter's Bite at the enemy in front, because it stops at the first enemy it hits. It leaves them slowed so your team can catch them.
Leap to your carry with Stand Behind Me when an enemy engages. You both get extra defenses on arrival.
Stand Behind Me also works on allied minions, so use one to close distance or escape.
Point Unbreakable toward the enemy shooters before they fire. It destroys their missiles and the first hit does no damage.
Unbreakable only covers the direction it faces, so enemies who come from the side or behind are not blocked.
Use Glacial Fissure at level 6 to knock up the enemy who dives your carry. Its icy zone then slows anyone chasing.
Aim Glacial Fissure from far away to knock up the first enemy longer. It takes a moment to cast, so start it early.

combos.name: Shield during W dash
combos.when: When you leap to an ally who is about to be hit by enemy projectiles.
combos.text: Cast Unbreakable while the leap is still in progress. You land with the shield already facing the enemy, so you block the incoming projectiles.

tips.text: Face Unbreakable toward Alistar when he comes in; it cuts the damage from his Pulverize and Trample.
Do not rely on Unbreakable against Headbutt; it is a targeted dash, so aim to stay out of his range instead.
Hit Alistar with Winter's Bite as he approaches. The slow makes it harder for him to reach you with Headbutt and Pulverize.
Wait out Unbreakable Will before you trade; his damage reduction makes your attacks weak.
Alistar's Pulverize has a short range, so stay just outside it and poke him with Winter's Bite.
Anivia's Flash Frost is slow and easy to see. Step out of its path, or raise Unbreakable toward her to destroy it.
Use Stand Behind Me on your carry when Anivia's Flash Frost is coming, so you both gain armor and magic resist.
Hit Anivia with Winter's Bite to start Concussive Blows, then have your partner attack her to reach the stun.
Look for the fight right after Anivia uses Flash Frost or Crystallize. She has fewer ways to keep you off her.
Kill her egg early if you can, and call for your jungler. Rebirth makes her hard to finish alone.
Raise Unbreakable toward Bard's Cosmic Binding; the bolt hits your shield and is destroyed, so neither of you gets slowed or stunned.
Hit Bard with Winter's Bite, then auto him. Your stacks of Concussive Blows build fast with your carry's attacks, and the fourth stack stuns him.
Walk over Caretaker's Shrine when you see it. An enemy stepping on it destroys it, so your lane partner's healing is denied.
Stay away from walls when Bard is lined up with you. Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits terrain after its first target, so fight in open space.
Use Glacial Fissure to cut off Bard's portal escape or a chase. The ice zone slows anyone who tries to run through it.
Do not stand in Tempered Fate's area while a fight is on. Anyone caught in it is frozen and can't act, so wait it out and then hit the target.
Raise Unbreakable toward Janna when she is about to cast Howling Gale or Zephyr; it blocks her projectiles.
Land Winter's Bite on Janna to start Concussive Blows, then have your ally attack her.
Listen for the charge-up of Howling Gale and move aside; its knock up is longer the longer she holds it.
Don't clump up when Janna has Monsoon ready; it knocks back everyone nearby and ruins your engage.
Raise Unbreakable toward Karma when she aims Inner Flame; the shield destroys her missile and the first hit deals no damage.
Hit Karma with Winter's Bite or a basic attack, then have your carry attack her to start stacking the stun.
Do not walk into Focused Resolve range carelessly. Step away to break the tether before she can root you.
Each hit on you shortens Karma's Mantra cooldown, so avoid free hits. Her empowered Inner Flame leaves a fire circle; leave it quickly.
Use Stand Behind Me on your carry when Karma's shield or root threatens them, so you land between them and the enemy.
Raise Unbreakable toward Leona as she engages. It destroys Zenith Blade and cuts the damage you take.
Use Winter's Bite on Leona as she walks up; it slows her and starts your Concussive Blows stacks.
Stay back when Unbreakable is on cooldown, because Leona can then dash onto you and stun you.
Move out of the center of Solar Flare when you see it land. Only the center stuns.
Jump to your carry with Stand Behind Me when Leona engages, so you land between them.
Raise Unbreakable toward Lulu before she fires; it destroys Glitterlance and Pix's bolts.
Hit Lulu with Winter's Bite to start Concussive Blows, then have your ally attack her to reach the stun.
Watch for Whimsy before you jump in; it stops you from attacking and moving well. Stay behind minions when approaching.
Stay behind minions so Pix's bolts hit them instead of you.
Hold Glacial Fissure for when Lulu uses Wild Growth to dive; its knock up and slow zone punish her team.
Raise Unbreakable toward Lux when she aims Light Binding at you or your carry. It stops the ball.
Land Winter's Bite on Lux to slow her and start your stun stacks. Then have your carry attack her.
Jump in with Stand Behind Me when your carry is caught by Light Binding, so you can close on Lux.
Move out of Lucent Singularity's zone instead of staying in it. It slows you and then detonates.
Use Glacial Fissure to knock Lux up when she is exposed. She has little to escape with.
Hit Maokai with Winter's Bite when he walks up; it slows him and starts your stun stacks. Your allies' attacks add to them.
Raise Unbreakable toward Maokai when he is about to throw a sapling or Bramble Smash; it destroys the projectile and shields you.
Stay out of brush where a sapling could sit; walk around it, because it chases you and deals more damage there.
Step out of the way of Nature's Grasp when you see it coming; it moves slowly at first, so there is time to dodge.
Hold Unbreakable up when Mel throws Radiant Barrage or Solar Snare at you. It stops her missiles, and the first hit does no damage.
Wait for Mel to use Rebuttal before you throw Glacial Fissure or Winter's Bite. It destroys enemy projectiles.
Start Concussive Blows with Winter's Bite, then have your carry attack Mel so she is stunned.
Back off when Mel has hit you a lot, because her next hit can kill you if your health is low. Let her stacks fall off first.
Use Stand Behind Me on a squishy ally Mel is targeting. The leap puts you in front of them, and you both gain resistances.
Aim Winter's Bite at Milio when he walks up to help his carry; it slows him and starts Concussive Blows.
Raise Unbreakable toward Milio's Ultra Mega Fire Kick; it hits your shield and is destroyed.
Glacial Fissure can cancel his Breath of Life plan: knock up his carry before he heals and cleanses.
Have your ally hit a marked target so Concussive Blows reaches the stun fast, before Milio can shield them.
Raise Unbreakable toward Nami's Aqua Prison; it intercepts the bubble missile and protects you and your partner from it.
Hit Nami with Winter's Bite to start Concussive Blows, then have your partner attack her to reach the stun fast.
Nami's Aqua Prison lands after a short delay, so keep moving unpredictably when she aims at you and look for a chance once she misses.
Use Glacial Fissure on Nami when she is caught forward; the knock up and slowed ground make it hard for her to escape.
Raise Unbreakable toward Nautilus when you see him ready to throw his anchor. It destroys the anchor, so he can't drag you.
Hit Nautilus with Winter's Bite when he walks up. It slows him, which gives you time to get away.
Do not stand still after Riptide goes off next to you. Wait for the waves to finish before moving away.
Use Stand Behind Me to jump to an ally as Nautilus engages. It gives you both extra Armor and Magic Resist.
Use Glacial Fissure to cut Nautilus off from your carry. The cold zone it leaves slows him if he walks through it.
Raise Unbreakable toward Pantheon as he leaps in; his first hit does no damage and later ones are reduced. Face the direction he comes from.
Hit Pantheon with Winter's Bite when he approaches; it slows him and starts Concussive Blows so your ally can finish the stun.
Pantheon stuns with Shield Vault, so keep Stand Behind Me ready to jump to your ally and give them armor and magic resist when he picks a target.
Stay away from Pantheon when your health is low; a hurled Comet Spear hits hard against weakened enemies.
When Pantheon uses Grand Starfall, you get a warning. Use Glacial Fissure on where he lands to knock him up and slow him.
Hit Pyke with Winter's Bite when he walks up, then hit him with basic attacks. Each hit starts Concussive Blows and sets up a stun.
Raise Unbreakable toward Pyke when he winds up Bone Skewer. His harpoon hits your shield and is destroyed, so your carry is safe.
Pyke heals back damage when you can't see him, so don't let him slip away. Keep chasing with Winter's Bite while he is low.
Use Glacial Fissure on Pyke after he dashes in or pulls someone. The knock up and the slow zone keep him from escaping.
Use Stand Behind Me on a low-health ally before Pyke can finish them with Death From Below. The extra armor and magic resist help them survive.
Hold Unbreakable for Rakan's Gleaming Quill; the shield stops the feather and the first hit does no damage.
Land Winter's Bite when Rakan dashes in; he is slowed and easy for your carry to catch.
Step away from the landing spot of Grand Entrance as soon as Rakan dashes; the knock up comes after a short delay.
Wait for Rakan to commit his dash before you use Glacial Fissure; its slow zone punishes a fast engage.
Use Stand Behind Me on your carry when Rakan engages; the extra Armor and Magic Resist blunt his burst.
Hit Senna with Winter's Bite when she walks up to attack; she is slowed and starts Concussive Blows for your lane partner to finish.
Raise Unbreakable toward Senna before she casts Last Embrace; it blocks the missile, so she can't root you.
Senna's Piercing Darkness is a beam that Unbreakable does not stop, so don't count on the shield against it.
Use Stand Behind Me on your lane partner when Senna threatens them; the armor and magic resist help against her physical damage.
Aim Glacial Fissure at Senna and her partner together once you hit level 6; the knock up lets your team burst them.
Raise Unbreakable toward Seraphine when she aims High Note or Beat Drop at your carry. It destroys the missiles.
Open with Winter's Bite so she is slowed, then let your carry attack to build your stun.
Dodge Beat Drop. If you are already slowed, it roots you instead.
Use Glacial Fissure when Encore's charm lands on your team. Walk out of her line if you can.
Leap onto your carry with Stand Behind Me when Seraphine shows she is about to poke.
Hit Shen with Winter's Bite when he walks up to trade; it slows him and starts Concussive Blows.
Raise Unbreakable toward Shen's Spirit Blade or his approach; it stops his Twilight Assault from reaching you.
Dodge Shadow Dash's taunt by staying out of its line, then punish him when he misses.
Watch for level 6; Shen can teleport in with Stand United, so don't overextend away from your team.
Land Winter's Bite on Sona to start Concussive Blows, then have your ally attack her for the stun.
Raise Unbreakable toward Sona when she casts Hymn of Valor; the shield stops her bolts.
Sona is fragile; Winter's Bite leaves her slowed, so follow up and kill her.
Use Stand Behind Me on your carry when Sona's Crescendo is near, then Unbreakable at once.
Stay spread out so Crescendo cannot stun your whole team.
Raise Unbreakable toward Swain when he goes for Nevermove or Death's Hand. It blocks the wave and cuts the damage.
Stay away from minions when Nevermove is ready. If you get rooted, Swain can pull you in with the recast.
Hit Swain with Winter's Bite when he walks up to cast. Being slowed makes his Death's Hand and Nevermove easier to dodge.
Keep moving when Vision of Empire appears on you. It takes a while to land, so step out of the circle.
Aim Glacial Fissure at Swain when he starts Demonic Ascension. The knock up interrupts his approach and the ice slows him.
Hold Unbreakable up toward Tahm Kench when he lashes at you or your carry; it stops Tongue Lash, and the first hit does no damage.
Hit Tahm Kench with Winter's Bite, then have your carry attack him so Concussive Blows stuns him sooner.
Watch for Tahm Kench channeling Abyssal Dive and move off the marked landing spot, or stun him to cancel it.
Leap onto your carry with Stand Behind Me when Tahm Kench has three stacks on them, so the armor and magic resist soften the follow-up.
Aim Glacial Fissure so its slowing ice lies between Tahm Kench and your team; he is slowed while crossing it.
Land Winter's Bite on Taric to start Concussive Blows, then have your carry hit him to build the stun.
Dazzle has a short delay before it stuns, so keep moving. Don't stand still when you see the wind-up.
Raise Unbreakable toward Taric before Dazzle fires; the beam is blocked and your carry is safe.
Punish Taric when he steps up to hit minions; Bravado makes his hits fast, so trade back hard.
When Cosmic Radiance starts, kill someone or back off before it ends; do not waste Glacial Fissure on invulnerable targets.
Hold Unbreakable up toward Thresh when he throws Death Sentence; the scythe hits your shield and is destroyed, so your carry is safe.
Watch Thresh's cast start on Death Sentence and step out of line. It has a long cast time, so you can dodge it.
Hit Thresh with Winter's Bite, then keep attacking with your ally to stun him with Concussive Blows. Do it when he steps up to trade.
Use Stand Behind Me on an ally that Thresh has hooked or is about to hook; the extra Armor and Magic Resist cushion his follow-up damage.
Aim Glacial Fissure so Thresh and his ally must cross the frozen ground, which leaves them slowed. Do not stand in The Box when you cast it.
Raise Unbreakable toward Vel'Koz when he aims at you or your partner. It destroys his missiles and protects your carry from poke.
Hit Vel'Koz with Winter's Bite. He has little mobility, so a slowed Vel'Koz is easy to reach and stack Concussive Blows on.
Interrupt Life Form Disintegration Ray with Glacial Fissure or a stun from Concussive Blows. Then lock him down.
Step aside from Tectonic Disruption's marked area as it lands; it knocks you up and stuns you if it hits.
Use Stand Behind Me to jump onto an ally in front of Vel'Koz and engage him.
Close the distance to Xerath; he's weak up close. Raise Unbreakable toward him to absorb his Shocking Orb as you walk in.
Hit Xerath with Winter's Bite when he charges Arcanopulse; he is already slowed and can't dodge well.
Stack Concussive Blows on Xerath with your ally's attacks so the stun lands when he is in reach.
Use Stand Behind Me to leap to your carry and block Xerath's poke before it hits them.
Hit Yuumi with Winter's Bite while she is not attached to an ally. Attached, she can't be targeted, so wait for her to detach.
Pick fights when Yuumi is alone and apart from her partner. Land your Concussive Blows marks on her to stun her.
Raise Unbreakable toward Yuumi's Prowling Projectile. It blocks the missile and the first hit does no damage.
Use Glacial Fissure when Yuumi detaches to dash. The knock up and slow zone make it hard for her to rejoin her partner.
Raise Unbreakable toward Zilean when he throws Time Bomb; it destroys the bomb on impact.
Use Winter's Bite on Zilean to start Concussive Blows; have your carry hit him until he is stunned.
Zilean has little health, so commit to killing him. Wait for Chronoshift to fade before you finish an ally.
Step away from a Time Bomb on you, or away from its partner, so a second bomb can't set it off and stun you.
Aim Glacial Fissure at Zilean when he is out of position. Its slow zone makes escaping hard.
Raise Unbreakable toward Zyra before she casts Grasping Roots; it stops the vines and the first hit does no damage.
Hit Zyra with Winter's Bite when she walks up to plant seeds. It slows her and starts your stacks.
Walk over seeds to destroy them before she can turn them into plants, especially in brush.
Zyra's plants have fixed damage and expire quickly, so back away from them or fight her somewhere with no seeds.
Use Stand Behind Me to leap onto your carry when Zyra aims at them. It gives you both extra resistances.
